segments.sn22.154:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa micchādiṭṭhi uppajjatī”ti?
segments.sn22.154:1.3: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa micchādiṭṭhi uppajjati.
segments.sn22.154:1.5: Vedanāya sati … micchādiṭṭhi uppajjati. Saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa micchādiṭṭhi uppajjati.
segments.sn22.154:1.9: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.154:1.12: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ … pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya micchādiṭṭhi uppajjeyyā”ti?
segments.sn22.154:1.15: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.154:1.20: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.154:1.22: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya micchādiṭṭhi uppajjeyyā”ti?
